questions.kind: Sources disagree (status report green vs later RAID/meeting: 2 weeks behind)
questions.q: Is the data migration on track?
questions.expect: No: the Oct 9 status report said green/on track, but the RAID log (Oct 16) and the Oct 19 sync-up say it's about 2 weeks behind because of the legacy claim code mapping. Should flag the disagreement.
questions.answer: Not anymore, by the latest sources. The October 9 status report showed data migration as Green and on track for the December 1 code freeze [S1]. Newer material says otherwise: the RAID log has an open risk R-01 (opened October 16, owner Ana Souza) noting that the legacy claim code mapping is incomplete and the migration is about 2 weeks behind plan [S3]. At the October 19 sync-up, about a third of the old claim codes didn't map cleanly, and Ana warned that if the mapping isn't done by the end of the month it will eat into the code freeze [S2][S5]. The scope question on closed claims older than seven years is also still waiting on legal [S2][S3].
